verdict.rationale: Docs describe launching multiple background cloud agents, tracking progress across sessions from a control plane, and scheduling automations to run agents on events/cron, which supports fleets working in parallel; however there's no explicit evidence of agents running autonomously for 'hours or days' or independent hands-on confirmation of long-running multi-day parallel fleets. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of long-duration (hours/days) autonomous runs, explicit scale limits on parallel agent count, and third-party confirmation of the fleet-management workflow.
